chip.description: ROZ (rotate and zoom) generator managing two affine layers, each a designated subset of a 256x256-tile master tilemap, with per-scanline ROZ attributes and per-layer colour and tile banking.
chip.notes: src/mame/namco/namco_c169roz.cpp in MAME 0.288, device full name "Namco C169 (ROZ)". Filed video-tilemap under taxonomy V3 and the §6 K051316 adjudication (an affine tile layer is still a tile layer). Used on Namco NB-2, System 2 and System FL.
